pinyinSentence: nǐ xū yào zài fā huò qián fù kuǎn.
meaningSentence: You need to make the payment before shipment.

hanziSentence: 请把款项转到我们的银行账户。
pinyinSentence: qǐng bǎ kuǎn xiàng zhuǎn dào wǒ men de yín háng zhàng hù.
meaningSentence: Please transfer the funds to our bank account.

hanziSentence: 我们已经通过银行转账付款。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men yǐ jīng tōng guò yín háng zhuǎn zhàng fù kuǎn.
meaningSentence: We have made the payment via bank transfer.

pinyinSentence: nín kě yǐ yòng xìn yòng kǎ fù kuǎn.
meaningSentence: You can pay with a credit card.

hanziSentence: 我们会通知您货物的发货时间。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men huì tōng zhī nín huò wù de fā huò shí jiān.
meaningSentence: We will notify you of the shipping time for the goods.
